about.bio1: Software developer based in Quito, Ecuador, guided by values of excellence. I am passionate about developing institutional web systems, native and mobile applications, with a focus on scalable architectures, Clean Architecture, security, and distributed development.
about.bio2: My experience spans Full-Stack development, working with frontend and backend technologies such as Angular, React Native, C# (.NET 8), Node.js, and Python, along with relational databases like SQL Server and MySQL. I integrate CQRS, Microservices, and secure design principles from the beginning of the development cycle.
about.bio3: In parallel, I am expanding my knowledge by pursuing a Software Engineering degree at UPS, which allows me to apply an analytical and structured approach to the systems I design. With a strong sensibility for clean code and layered architecture, I enjoy transforming complex business rules into high-performance, easy-to-maintain digital products.
about.valuesDesc: Clean Code, standardized maintainability, auditable code, and layered architecture.
about.securityDesc: DevSecOps principles, secure hashing, JWT tokens, and strict role control.
